scope: Exact frozen LongMemEval scope-policy diagnostic only: four pairs, up to eight answers and eight native judgments, two workers.

findings.detail: Both pair and judge stop for capacity codes 1302/1305 regardless of HTTP status, as well as 429/503. Regression tests preserve known costs and block remaining pair work.
Judge health predicate validates nonnegative integer components and their exact sum; malformed truthy usage stops new work and remains reserved.
All 35 static imported files reachable from live/score and the continuity policy are bound; all 770 source hashes and native continuity validation pass.

Four pairs, eight assigned answers; failures remain in arm denominators. Two workers. Generation cap 64000 plus judge cap 58880 equals 122880. Known failed costs included; unknown usage prevents new judging and success.

Generation uses identical source projection with generic policy as the intervention. Gold/native rubric loaded only in evaluator command after terminal generation. Every request is retokenized; answer cap 6976+1024=8000, judge cap 6976+384=7360. Eight real preflight prompts have maximum input plus reserve 3748.

Four already exposed development tasks, one repetition, same-model native rubric judge. Same-evidence answer-policy comparison cannot establish full-history savings, heldout performance, full-benchmark perfection or campaign achievement.
